records.name: Malta Classic Car Collection
records.address: Tourist Street, Qawra SPB 1020, Malta (official listing; confirm the map pin before travel).
records.hours: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00; Saturday, Sunday and public holidays 09:00–14:00 (official museum page).
records.price range: Adult €10; child €4.50 according to the official ticket page. The retrieved page did not specify the age boundary for the child rate.
records.description: A Qawra museum displaying classic cars and related memorabilia. The museum's access statement describes a wheelchair-friendly ramp to the entrance and a lift between the exhibition floors, but also notes a five-step route to restroom facilities and other access limitations.
records.notes: Hours and ticket prices were checked on current official pages. The official museum-location route returned 404; the address is from the museum's official indexed listing and should be pinned again before travel. S-IDs C-003–C-005.

details.accessibility: Official access statement: the museum exhibition is on two floors connected by stairs and a wheelchair-friendly lift; the entrance route includes a five-step staircase plus ramp to the terrace, and restroom facilities are reached via five steps. Contact the museum about individual access needs.
